// FILE: /index.ts
import {defineRenderOnLoadActions, FDO_SDK, FDOInterface, PluginMetadata, PluginRegistry} from '@anikitenko/fdo-sdk';
import {Render} from "./render"

export default class MyPlugin extends FDO_SDK implements FDOInterface {

    private readonly _metadata: PluginMetadata = {
        name: "Quasar Quill",
        version: "1.0.0",
        author: "AleXvWaN",
        description: "A sample FDO plugin",
        icon: "cog",
    };

    get metadata(): PluginMetadata {
        return this._metadata;
    }
    
    init(): void {
        PluginRegistry.registerHandler("refreshStatus", () => ({
            success: true,
            message: this.metadata.name + " is running (v" + this.metadata.version + ").",
        }));
        this.info(this.metadata.name + " initialized!", {
            plugin: this.metadata.name,
            version: this.metadata.version,
        });
    }
    
    render(): string {
        const metadata = this.metadata;
        return (Render({
            version: metadata.version,
            author: metadata.author,
            description: metadata.description
        }))
    }
    
    renderOnLoad() {
        return defineRenderOnLoadActions({
            handlers: {
                refreshStatus: async ({ element }) => {
                    const response = await window.createBackendReq("UI_MESSAGE", {
                        handler: "refreshStatus",
                        content: {
                            plugin: "Quasar Quill",
                        },
                    });
                    const target = document.querySelector("[data-role=\"status\"]");
                    if (target) {
                        target.textContent = String(response?.message || "Status updated");
                    }
                    if (element instanceof HTMLElement) {
                        element.dataset.state = "ready";
                    }
                },
            },
            bindings: [
                {
                    selector: "[data-role=\"refresh-status\"]",
                    event: "click",
                    handler: "refreshStatus",
                    preventDefault: true,
                    required: true,
                },
            ],
            // strict: true surfaces selector mismatch diagnostics early during plugin authoring.
            strict: true,
            language: "typescript",
        });
    }
    
}

new MyPlugin();

// FILE: /render.tsx
import {DOM, DOMNested, DOMText} from '@anikitenko/fdo-sdk';

type RenderProps = {
    version: string;
    author: string;
    description: string
}

export const Render = ({ version, author, description }: RenderProps): string => {
    const text = new DOMText();
    const myPlugin = text.createHText(1, `Quasar Quill`);
    const pVersion = text.createPText(`Version: ${version}`);
    const pAuthor = text.createPText(`Author: ${author}`);
    const pDescription = text.createPText(`Description: ${description}`);
    const refreshButton = new DOM().createElement("button", {
        "data-role": "refresh-status",
        type: "button",
        class: "pure-button",
    }, "Refresh status");
    const status = new DOM().createElement("p", {
        "data-role": "status",
    }, "Click the button to fetch plugin UI status.");
    const nested = new DOMNested().createBlockDiv([
        myPlugin,
        pVersion,
        pAuthor,
        pDescription,
        refreshButton,
        status
    ]);
    return (
        new DOM().renderHTML(nested)
    )
}
